title.en: The instrumental case: with, by means of, as

card: The instrumental answers **кем? чем?**: the tool or means (**писа́ть ру́чкой**), company with **с** (**ко́фе с молоко́м**), and what someone *is, becomes or works as* (**Он рабо́тает врачо́м**). Endings: **-ом/-ем** (masc./neut.), **-ой/-ей** (fem. **-а/-я**), **-ью** (fem. **-ь**).

sections.body: The name comes from *instrument*: the oldest use is the means by which something is done, **писа́ть карандашо́м** (*to write with a pencil*), **е́хать по́ездом** (*to go by train*). From there it spread to *together with* (after **с**), to roles and professions, and to several prepositions of position.

sections.title: The 5-letter rule
sections.body: After **ж, ш, щ, ч, ц** an **unstressed** **о** in an ending is written **е**: **ме́сяцем**, **му́жем**, **ка́шей**, **у́лицей**. When stressed it stays **о**: **отцо́м**, **ножо́м**, **душо́й**. So say the word, find the stress, then choose the letter.

sections.title: The main uses
sections.body:
- **Tool or means**: **ре́зать ножо́м**, **е́хать авто́бусом**, **писа́ть ле́вой руко́й**.
- **With someone or something** (**с**): **ча́й с лимо́ном**, **гуля́ть с соба́кой**, **Мы с бра́том** (*my brother and I*).
- **Professions and roles** after **рабо́тать**, **быть** (past and future), **стать**: **Она́ ста́ла врачо́м.** **Я бу́ду учи́телем.** In the present tense there is no verb and the nominative is used: **Она́ врач.**
- **Verbs of interest and occupation**: **занима́ться спо́ртом**, **интересова́ться му́зыкой**, **по́льзоваться телефо́ном**.
- **Position**: **над** (*above*), **под** (*under*), **пе́ред** (*in front of*), **за** (*behind*), **ме́жду** (*between*): **под столо́м**, **пе́ред до́мом**.
- **Times of day and seasons** as adverbs: **у́тром**, **ве́чером**, **но́чью**, **ле́том**, **зимо́й**.

table.caption: After a preposition, third-person forms gain **н-**: **с ним**, **с ней**, **с ни́ми**.

sections.body: English *with* covers two different Russian ideas. *With a knife* (the tool) is the bare instrumental: **ножо́м**, no preposition. *With a friend* (company) needs **с**: **с дру́гом**. Saying **с ножо́м** means *carrying a knife*, not *using* it.

mistakes.why: A tool takes the bare instrumental; **с** means *together with*.
After **стать** the profession goes in the instrumental.

examples.en: My sister works as a doctor.
The cat is sleeping under the table.

examples.ru: Мы с дру́гом идём в кино́.
examples.en: My friend and I are going to the cinema.
In summer we live at the dacha.
